A Matryoshka model is trained so that the first k numbers of its vector work as an embedding by themselves. You can store 256 numbers of a 1024-number vector and give up a little quality. Jina v5 lists every size from 32 to 1024 as supported. The EmbeddingGemma 2 card reports its MTEB English score falling from 68.46 at 768 dimensions to 67.78 at 256, a loss of 0.68 points for a vector one third the size, and to 65.68 at 128.
Qwen3-Embedding expects a task instruction on the query side. Its card says instructions typically add 1 to 5 points and recommends writing them in English.
67.88 vs 70.58 Text-only MMTEB task mean: Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B vs Qwen3-Embedding-8B, a gap of 2.70. At 2B it is 63.87 against 64.33 for a 0.6B text model. Vendor measurement
